typical_titles: MD and CEO; Chief Financial Officer; Chief Operating Officer
owns: The budget for collections and customer service. Also the cost-to-income target.
cares_about: Cost per call and cost per rupee collected. Recovery that does not rise with headcount. Bajaj's technology and operations chief says the AI cost must be below the human cost. He gives one-third as the voice AI figure. The link to Sarvam is INFERENCE.
blocks_if: The pilot has no result the CFO can check against the human baseline. Or the vendor price rises as call volume grows.
where_found: Concall participant list; annual report KMP list; leadership page
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Chief Credit Officer; Head of Collections; Chief Credit and Collections Officer
owns: Recovery targets by overdue bucket. The size and rules of the calling team.
cares_about: Flow rates from early to late buckets. Bounce rate (failed repayments) and collection efficiency. Kissht reports a 13.1% bounce rate and 97.01% collection efficiency. AU reports 99.5% collection efficiency. The two firms may measure it in different ways.
blocks_if: The bot cannot capture a promise to pay or route a hard case to a human. Or it hurts repayment rates in a pilot.
where_found: Leadership page; concall participant list; HDB's governance code names a Head of Collections
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Head of Customer Service; Chief of Operations and Customer Service; Head of Operations; Chief Customer Service Officer
owns: The contact centre, service requests and complaint handling. Often the first daily user of a voice agent.
cares_about: Share of calls handled with no manual step. ABCL says 63% of contact centre interactions went through straight-through processing (STP, which means no manual step). Languages the floor cannot cover.
blocks_if: Agents must type the data in again after the bot hands off. Or the bot fails in a language the team does not speak.
where_found: Leadership page (PNB Housing, Poonawalla, SBI Card and CreditAccess Grameen all name such a role); LinkedIn title search
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Chief Technology Officer; Chief Information Officer; Chief Digital and AI Officer
owns: Links to the loan origination and loan management systems, the dialer and the call-recording stack. Security review.
cares_about: Speed of reply, links to the dialer and the core systems, call recording, and who can reach call data. AU names a Chief Digital and AI Officer on its call.
blocks_if: The vendor cannot show where it stores call audio. Or it cannot link to the dialer. Or one model does not cover the languages the lender serves.
where_found: Concall participant list; leadership page; LinkedIn title search
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Chief Risk Officer; Chief Compliance Officer
owns: Recovery conduct policy, the code of conduct for agents and staff, and call records.
cares_about: RBI recovery directions of 6 Aug 2026 (in force 1 Jan 2027). They apply to NBFCs. Banks have separate directions with the same recording and call-hour rules. Calls only between 08:00 and 19:00 (unless the borrower expressly asks or authorises another time). Call time and number of calls documented. Call content recorded and kept six months. Recovery agents hold an IIBF certificate within one year. Graded escalation matrix. The lender stays answerable for its recovery agents.
blocks_if: A voice agent calls outside hours, or calls too often, or records nothing. Or the vendor cannot prove it follows the lender's code of conduct.
where_found: Annual report KMP list; leadership page; RBI directions text
label: PUBLISHED

role: Risk and compliance (grievance and vendor risk)
typical_titles: Grievance Redressal Officer; Principal Nodal Officer; Head of Outsourcing or Vendor Risk
owns: Outsourcing policy and vendor checks. Complaint handling under the RBI Fair Practices Code and the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme.
cares_about: RBI outsourcing directions of 28 Nov 2025: the lender is responsible for the actions of its service provider, recovery agents included. The lender keeps ultimate control. The lender must display the name and contact details of its grievance officer.
blocks_if: The vendor is a black box. Or the contract does not let the lender audit calls, or the vendor cannot show how it keeps a complaint trail.
where_found: Lender's website grievance page; LinkedIn title search
label: PUBLISHED

typical_titles: Head of Procurement; Vendor Management; Chief Operating Officer office
owns: Commercial terms, the price model and the contract.
cares_about: A per-minute price the lender can test on a small pilot. Sarvam's page lists Rs 3.50 a minute pay as you go, plus telephony. Compare completed outcomes, not the headline rate.
blocks_if: Telephony, setup and integration costs are not on the quote. Or the price is not published.
where_found: LinkedIn title search; tender or vendor-onboarding contact. No public name found.
label: INFERENCE

typical_titles: Chief Digital Officer; Head of Digital; AI or Transformation lead
owns: The proof of concept. PNB Housing says it finished a Voice AI proof of concept for pre-due collections. ABCL says it deploys Voice AI across onboarding, servicing and cross sell.
cares_about: A result the lender can show its own board. A small first test that does not need a long project.
blocks_if: The sponsor leaves, or the proof of concept has no named owner after the pilot.
where_found: Concall prepared remarks (the person who presents the AI slide); LinkedIn title search
label: INFERENCE
